rows.en: So you've lost your nerve! Fuhahahahahahaha!!
We can't beat the Modified Bemstar as we are now! We need to rethink our strategy back at base!
Up ahead is the area with the cross.
There's a cross in the distance...!
So that's where they're holding the Ultra Warriors!
The Ultra Warriors are over there!
The Ultra Warriors... they're over there!
The Ultra Warriors are over there!
The Ultra Warriors are over there...!
Hey, Ultra Warriors, I'm comin' to save ya right now! Just you wait!
So the Ultra Warriors have been crucified...
The Ultra Warriors... they've been crucified...
The Ultra Warriors are over there!
Hey! You there! Do you know anything about the Devil Gundam?
If you don't know, then never mind.
If you don't know, then never mind.
Huh? It ain't gonna come at us?
What is that...? Is it an enemy...?
What is that...? Is it an enemy...?
What is that...? Is it an enemy...?
What is that...? Is it an enemy...?
What the!? Some creepy thing just showed up!
What is that...? Is it Crisis...!?
Don't tell me... it possessed Gomora!?
It's suddenly gone wild!! Is it because that thing from before possessed it!?
It's suddenly gone wild!! Is it because that thing from before possessed it!?
Wh-what the hell!? What the heck's gotten into it all of a sudden!?

notes.note: No speaker; the line shown after losing to the Modified Bemstar. Rendered with 'we' (the party), since the scene settles it is the team speaking/deciding.

Party-leader variants 0317 #0.4-0.13 follow the order seen in story_048 (0316 #0.12-0.21): Mebius, Zero, OOO, W, Nu Gundam, Zeta Gundam, Den-O, 00, Wing Zero, Black RX. #0.4 'nii-san-tachi' = Mebius's Ultra Brothers -> 'My brothers'. #0.10 is Den-O (Momotaros's rough speech).
'haritsuke' = crucified/bound to the crosses; #0.11-0.12 are 00 and Wing Zero by the variant order. Kept 'cross' to match 0312 #0.112 ('the area with the cross').

Unknown speaker (???) searching for the Devil Gundam; reappears in 0323 explaining DG cells. Gender not stated, so no pronouns used. Article 'the' added before Devil Gundam in full sentences; the echo replies keep the bare name.
Labelled Den-O Sword Form, but #0.2-0.11 and #0.15-0.23 are identical party-leader variants; label applies only to the first variant. Kept identical text for all.
'...nanda?' after the stranger leaves: rendered 'What was that about?' to avoid gendering the unknown speaker.

0321 splits the party: two-variant rows (#0.2-0.3, #0.5-0.6, #0.32-0.33) are the Ultras (Mebius, Zero), who know Gomora; eight-variant rows (#0.20-0.27, #0.34-0.41) are OOO, W, Nu, Zeta, Den-O (#0.24/#0.38 rough), 00, Wing Zero, Black RX (#0.41 mentions Crisis). Confirms the order.
'Omae wa...!?' from Mebius/Zero to the ??? figure: kept as recognition-ambiguous 'You're...!?'; the figure's identity is not revealed here.
New Gomora roars (no earlier English for these): 'Gyaaaaaaaaah!!' and 'Gwaaaaaaaaah!!'. Reuse if the same roars recur (also in story_178, story_194).

Subject of 'toritsuita' (possessed) is the ??? figure that just appeared, rendered 'it' (non-human/unknown). #0.45-0.48 = Mebius, Zero, OOO, W; #0.49-0.50 Nu/Zeta ('koitsu kyuu ni' = it suddenly went wild, matching #0.52-0.54 in story_050); #0.51 Den-O.

report: 80/80 rows. Party-leader variants mapped by the order from story_048 (Mebius, Zero, OOO, W, Nu, Zeta, Den-O, 00, Wing Zero, RX); speaker labels on first variants unreliable. New Gomora roars. ??? (Devil Gundam seeker) kept ungendered. No names outside the glossary.
